about.title: Things with a story
about.p1: , Rector of the Kyiv School of Economics, is giving his personal belongings to an auction. Each one is a separate lot, and all proceeds go to charity.

when.a: We are opening the site with the lots in advance so you can look through everything and pick your favourites. The bidding itself takes place live at an offline event with Rector Tymofiy Brik (tentatively 4 December).

bidding.a: Bidding takes place live. You can browse the lots on the site in advance. During the event, people in the hall bid by raising numbered paddles, and viewers of the YouTube stream can scan the QR code on screen and place a bid on the site.

bid.a: Your bid during the auction is a formal commitment to buy the lot for the amount you named if you win. All bids are charitable, so please place them thoughtfully.

who.a: In the hall: students, faculty, KSE staff, alumni and guests of the university who register for the offline event (the number of seats is limited). Online, you can join through the stream: scan the QR code on screen and sign in on the site to place a bid.

payment.q: How do I pay for and receive a lot I won?
payment.a: Right after winning, you transfer the bid amount to the official fundraising jar (by QR code). Once payment is confirmed, the coordinator releases the lot to you right at the event, and the Rector presents it and takes a photo with you.

funds.a: All funds raised at the auction will go to charitable initiatives that the KSE Student Council will choose and approve after the event.

sections.p: Anyone aged 18 or over who has registered on the site and agreed to these rules.
Each bid must beat the current one by at least the lot's step. Bids are accepted only on the lot currently shown on air. Bids from the room or by phone are entered by the auction administrator.
By bidding you commit to buy the lot if your bid wins. Refusing to pay leads to your account being blocked.
The host closes bidding on each lot during the show. The highest valid bid at closing wins. The winner's full name is announced on air and shown on the site.
The winner pays within 7 days of closing by bank transfer to the fundraising account. The Rector's Office will send the details.
Pick-up from the KSE Rector's Office in Kyiv, or Nova Poshta delivery at the buyer's expense. International delivery by arrangement.
The lot may be offered to the bidder with the next highest bid.
The auction may be changed or cancelled for objective reasons, including the war or the security situation.
Your name, email and phone, and your bids.
So you can bid and get notifications about your bids, and so the Rector's Office can contact winners about payment and handover.

Only the auction's administrators at the KSE Rector's Office see your contacts. The public bid history shows your first name and surname initial. The full name of each lot's winner is announced on air and shown on the site.
Data is stored on secure servers in the EU and is never shared with third parties.
You can ask us to delete your data by writing to the Rector's Office. After the auction ends, data is deleted within an agreed period.
